package.name: ares_erc_bringup
package.description: ERC (European Rover Challenge) GPS-free autonomy bring-up for the ARES rover. Phase 0: Livox Mid-360 + FAST-LIO2 mapping to a saved .pcd point-cloud map. Holds ERC-specific launch/config; the FAST-LIO2 backbone (package: fast_lio) and the Livox driver (livox_ros_driver2) are used unmodified.
